data.name: Poovarasan
data.long_meaning: One who rules over the river Poova. Poovarasan is a popular Hindu name inspired by Lord Shiva, the supreme god in Hinduism. The name is derived from the Tamil words 'poo' meaning river and 'varasan' meaning the ruler. Thus, Poovarasan is a name that signifies power, strength, and the ability to protect.

data.cultural_impact: The name Poovarasan holds significant cultural importance in Tamil Nadu, India. It reflects the connection between the people and the rivers, an essential aspect of Tamil culture. The Hindu deity Cauvery, also known as River Goddess, holds a special place in Tamil literature and folklore. The name Poovarasan pays homage to the power and significance of rivers in Tamil Nadu.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the god Shiva is often depicted as a ruler, a protector, and a destroyer. The name Poovarasan carries this spiritual significance as it symbolizes the power of Lord Shiva over the river Poova. It also illustrates the concept of the divine presence in nature and the connection between the divine and the human world. The name Poovarasan serves as a reminder of the ultimate power and control of God over all creation.
